kpis.description_fr: Biktarvy = #1 mondial HIV. ~45 % du CA Gilead. Croissance double-digit malgré LOE 2033. Standard of care HIV.
kpis.description_en: Biktarvy = #1 HIV globally. ~45% of Gilead revenue. Double-digit growth despite 2033 LOE. HIV standard of care.

kpis.description_fr: Franchise HIV totale ~20 Mds $ (Biktarvy + Descovy + Genvoya + autres). Dominance ~70 % marché HIV mondial.
kpis.description_en: Total HIV franchise ~$20B (Biktarvy + Descovy + Genvoya + others). ~70% global HIV market dominance.

kpis.description_fr: Oncology = Trodelvy (TNBC, urothelial) + Yescarta (CAR-T) + Tecartus. Diversification post-acquisition Immunomedics 2020.
kpis.description_en: Oncology = Trodelvy (TNBC, urothelial) + Yescarta (CAR-T) + Tecartus. Post-2020 Immunomedics acquisition diversification.

kpis.description_fr: Liver = HCV (Sovaldi/Harvoni/Epclusa) en décliné + Vemlidy (HBV). Future = MASH program (Resmetrium et al).
kpis.description_en: Liver = HCV (Sovaldi/Harvoni/Epclusa) declining + Vemlidy (HBV). Future = MASH program (Resmetrium et al).

kpis.description_fr: Yeztugo (Lenacapavir 2x/an HIV PrEP) approuvé FDA juin 2025. Potential blockbuster avec 100 % efficacité prévention HIV (PURPOSE trials).
kpis.description_en: Yeztugo (Lenacapavir 2x/year HIV PrEP) FDA-approved June 2025. Potential blockbuster with 100% HIV prevention efficacy (PURPOSE trials).
